campus_notes: Compiled 2026-09-14 from Syracuse University Housing's official residence-hall directory. Syracuse publishes each hall's neighborhood, capacity and exact mix of room types — including its distinctive split double, a room divided by a wall into two halves — but no room dimensions, so every room here uses the site's estimate fallback and is labelled "Estimated based on similar rooms. Official size not published." Beds are Twin XL. Worth knowing before you plan: a split double is two narrow halves, not one open rectangle, so a layout drawn for an open double will not transfer.
